lines.text: I still think about you late at night
Wondering if we could have got it right
Every song I hear just pulls me back
To the love we almost had
I don’t know what to do
Still stuck on me and you
We were almost in love
Almost close enough
Almost said the words
But almost wasn’t enough
You said the timing never worked out right
I told myself that I would be just fine
Now I know that almost doesn’t mean
We were ever meant to be
I don’t know what to do
Still stuck on me and you
We were almost in love
Almost close enough
Almost said the words
But almost wasn’t enough
Maybe one day I won’t feel this way
But it still hurts me every day
We were almost in love
Almost close enough
I’m learning how to let you go
Even though it hurts me so
